leadIn: By the end of this lesson, learners will be able to:
objectives: Define a generic function signature with a type parameter <T> to create a reusable data fetching hook.
Implement useState hooks with generic types to manage loading, error, and data states.
Apply useEffect hooks to execute side effects for fetching data from an API endpoint.
Utilize TypeScript interfaces to define the expected shape of API response data.
Execute async/await patterns within useEffect to handle asynchronous API calls.
Construct conditional rendering logic based on loading, error, and data states.
Invoke the custom useFetch<T> hook within a React component to retrieve and display typed data.
Assign proper TypeScript types to the data state to ensure type safety throughout the component.
Control component re-renders by specifying dependencies in the useEffect dependency array.
Return structured JSX that conditionally displays loading indicators, error messages, or fetched data.
Modify the generic type parameter when calling useFetch to adapt it for different data structures.
Handle API errors by catching exceptions and updating the error state appropriately.
